title: Lao PDR PM arrives in PH ahead of Asean Summit

blocks.text: Screengrab from ASEAN Philippines 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Prime Minister of Lao People’s Democratic Republic (PDR) Saleumxay Kommasith on Saturday arrived in the Philippines ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. The arrival of foreign leaders and delegations from the 11 member states comes as the country prepares to host the regional high-stakes gathering on Nov. 15 to Nov. 17. READ: Asean at a glance: Meet the bloc’s 11 member states Dialogue partners China, South Korea, Japan, United States, Australia, New Zealand, India and Canada are also expected to join the 49th Asean Summit.
